messages.content: amar mone hoy amake keu seriously nei na, sob soft answer dey
I won't do that then. What specifically made you feel that way today?
amar idea ta niye office e keu react e korlo na, jeno matter e kore na
Silence can genuinely mean disinterest, or it can just mean people were distracted and didn't process it. Did you follow up directly with anyone, or did you let it sit after the first mention?
na follow up kori nai, ekbar e bole chere disichi
Honestly, one mention rarely lands the way we hope it will in a busy environment. Before assuming no one cares, try following up directly with one person who'd actually be relevant to it.
